analogy.rationale: The annotated targets ALPPL2 and CHRNA3 are not canonical immunostimulatory pathways, and CHRNA3 (nicotinic acetylcholine receptor) is poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest reference classes are cholinergic receptor agonists/antagonists that share the CHRNA3 target, while unrelated immunostimulant-like classes are not represented in the list.
